story: The Black Crowned Pitta (Erythropitta ussheri) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Pittidae family. Listed as Near Threatened (NT) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Black Crowned Pitta is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists.
